nodes.description: Contract state variable maximumBalance storing the current maximum allowed bet.
Contract state variable rewardnumber storing the last random draw result.
Privileged owner address set in constructor and used for access control.
Declared minimumBet state variable, never initialised or used.
Mapping of address to raceDetails storing per-player game history.
Dynamic array of all addresses that have played the game.
msg.sender, attacker controlled caller address used for transfers and mapping keys.
block.timestamp, miner influenced value used to seed the pseudo random generator.
msg.sender.transfer(msg.value.mul(2)) external value transfer executed before state accounting is finalised.
manager.transfer(amount*1000000000000000) sends ether to the manager address.
amount * 1000000000000000 raw multiplication that can overflow before the transfer.
keccak256(block.difficulty, block.timestamp, now) weak on-chain randomness source.
listofUsers.push(msg.sender) - 1 unchecked arithmetic on the returned length, result discarded.
SafeMath.mul multiplies two uint256 with an overflow assertion.
SafeMath.div divides two uint256.
SafeMath.sub subtracts two uint256 with an underflow assertion.
SafeMath.add adds two uint256 with an overflow assertion.
Constructor assigning manager = msg.sender.
random() private view returning a hash based pseudo random number.
enter(uint256) payable betting entry point that decides win/loss and pays out.
getMaximumBetRate() returns contract balance divided by 20.
randomtests() private returns random() % 100 used as the game outcome.
getAccounts() returns the listofUsers array.
numberofGamePlay() returns listofUsers.length.
uint2str(uint) converts an unsigned integer to its decimal string representation.
getAccDetails(address) returns stored race details and a win/loss message.
getEthBalance() returns the contract ether balance.
depositEther() payable, restricted to the manager.
withDrawalether(uint) payable, restricted to the manager, transfers scaled ether.

edges.reason: msg.sender becomes the privileged manager during construction.
Constructor writes msg.sender into the manager state variable.
block.timestamp feeds the keccak256 randomness expression.
random() computes the hash of block.difficulty, block.timestamp and now.
randomtests() consumes the weak random() output.
enter() derives rewardnumber from randomtests, so payout depends on miner-influenced values.
enter() calls getMaximumBetRate() to bound the bet.
getMaximumBetRate result is stored in maximumBalance.
enter() writes maximumBalance before validating msg.value.
randomtests result is stored into rewardnumber.
enter() assigns rewardnumber in both branches.
enter() writes raceDetails into the members mapping for msg.sender.
enter() pushes msg.sender into listofUsers.
enter() transfers ether to the caller before/while state accounting is incomplete.
transfer to msg.sender can invoke attacker controlled fallback code.
Transfer recipient is the untrusted msg.sender.
msg.sender is used as mapping key and array element inside enter().
push return value has an unchecked minus one operation.
withDrawalether() executes the transfer to manager.
withDrawalether() multiplies amount by 1e15 without overflow protection.
User supplied amount parameter feeds the unchecked multiplication.
manager address is the recipient of the withdrawn funds.
depositEther compares msg.sender against manager.
manager is the reference value in the depositEther authorisation check.
withDrawalether compares msg.sender against manager.
manager is the reference value in the withDrawalether authorisation check.
getAccDetails reads stored raceDetails from the members mapping.
getAccDetails reads the global rewardnumber to decide win or loss text.
getAccDetails calls uint2str for string conversion.
Address parameter indexes the members mapping in getAccDetails.
getAccounts returns the listofUsers state array.
numberofGamePlay reads listofUsers.length.
Integer parameter i is consumed by uint2str.
leftorright parameter drives both conditional branches of enter.
SafeMath.mul computes the product into local c and asserts against overflow.
SafeMath.div computes the quotient into local c.
SafeMath.add computes the sum into local c and asserts against overflow.
randomtests stores the modulo of the weak random value in index.
uint2str copies i into local j for digit counting.
uint2str accumulates the digit count in length.
uint2str allocates the resulting bytes buffer bstr.
uint2str writes characters using the local index k.
